channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: France to summon Iran envoy after language centre closure in Tehran
item.description: Iran accuses the French language centre of conducting 'illegal acts that violated diplomatic conventions'.

item.title: Qatar PM urges Gulf security framework with Iran
item.description: Qatar’s PM says, the Gulf won't be the same unless there's a framework ensuring no one is a threat to each other.

item.title: Qatar PM describes fallout of US-Israel war on Iran as ‘earthquake’
item.description: Speaking before the UN General Assembly, Sheikh Mohammed also announces a key shift in Qatar's investment strategy.

item.title: Qatar says it is working to revive Iran-US talks
item.description: Qatar’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson tells Bloomberg that mediators are shuttling between Iran and US to revive talks.

item.title: How will Saudi Arabia deal with the Houthis?
item.description: Yemeni group warns of further attacks on the kingdom.

item.title: Man Utd salvage Fulham draw as pressure mounts on Carrick
item.description: Matheus Cunha strikes late as Manchester United seal a 1-1 draw at Fulham, but pressure mounts on Michael Carrick.

item.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
item.description: The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

item.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
item.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

item.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
item.description: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.
